en.answer: Even in this case, the first effect of <<11722>> will apply. Since the original Attribute of <<7351>> is DARK, your opponent will not be able to activate the effects of DARK monsters.
en.question: If <<7351>> gained the name of <<11240>>, and is used to Synchro Summon <<11722>>, how will the first effect of <<11722>> be applied?

ja.answer:
質問の状況の場合でも、「<<11722>>」の効果は適用されます。
